text:
sam: Heads-up — we just got an SLO alert: customer inference endpoints 5xx spike and paging didn't reach oncall. IncidentBot posted suppressed pages.
IncidentBot: [ALERT] 3 pages suppressed by dedupe_suppress (key=0x000000)
maria: I'm oncall and didn't get any page until now, saw only this thread.
sam: Logs show pagerflow received webhook but dedupe key normalized to constant after the 02:13 deploy. Looks like all pages collapsed.
alex: I deployed alert-formatter earlier; quick glance shows when FEATURE_DEDUPE=true we replace missing user_id with `-` which ended up as a stable dedupe token. my bad.
maria: Can we hotfix or rollback? Customers impacted: 3 tenants with increased 503s.
alex: rolling back alert-formatter now: `kubectl -n notify rollout undo deployment/alert-formatter --to-revision=3`
IncidentBot: @maria manual page attempt queued.
maria: Received manual page. Starting incident bridge. Assigning triage: @alex (formatter), @lee (pagerflow), @michael (sre)
lee: Investigating proxy logs — proxy rewrite stripped `X-Dedupe-Id` header in 02:12 deploy. Pagerflow treated missing header as zero hash and suppressed duplicates.
alex: I have a PR to stop emitting `-` and preserve nulls; will merge after smoke test. Also pushing a hotfix to re-add header fallback in proxy.
michael: Mitigation plan: 1) rollback formatter (done) 2) restart proxy to get header passthrough 3) trigger synthetic paging test across regions. I'll coordinate.
sam: Customer impact numbers: ~1,200 failed requests across us-west-2 & eu-west-1 over ~12m. Investigating whether retries caused downstream errors. Logs: https://logs.redwood.example/streams/abcd
maria: Action items: confirm rollback stable, merge proxy fix, run e2e page test, prepare customer comms and postmortem. Also file follow-up to IncidentBot to surface suppressed-page reasons in channel.
alex: Merged fix to alert-formatter and proxy patch. Running tests now.
IncidentBot: Incident created INC-2026-042 — runbook attached (link).
maria: After fixes, monitor for 30m. If no regressions, we'll transition to postmortem. Thanks team :thumbsup:
